why_this_part: Candidate for the 'faster complementary output pair' alternative to the MJE15032/MJE15033 emitter follower (NC-024, NC-025: model CJE 3.06 nF, model fT below datasheet minimum, forcing a 1 nF Miller). The manufacturer's model has CJE = 192 pF and fT about 150 MHz at the follower's 20 mA. Chosen over onsemi KSC3503/KSA1381 (which also have manufacturer models for both polarities and even smaller capacitances) because onsemi lists KSC3503DS as 'Last Shipments' and KSC3503DSTU as 'Obsolete' on its own product page (read 2026-10-01): the NPN half is end-of-life, which fails the project's T8. Chosen over BD139/BD140 because those datasheets specify no fT or Cob at all and half the grades are discontinued.
how_the_model_url_was_found: Diodes' model index page answers 403. Per docs/limitations.md #21 the id alone selects the file, so ids 2800-3060 were probed and the NAME in the response Content-Type was read for each. id 2802 answers name="ZXTN25040DZ.spice.txt". The file was then opened and its own header read: '*ZETEX ZXTN25040DZ Spice Model v1.0 Last revision 01/06/07' and '.MODEL ZXTN25040DZ NPN' - the right part, SOT-89 variant (limitations #20).
revision_note: Datasheet footer: 'Document number: DS33699 Rev. 3 - 2', January 2021. Model: 'Spice Model v1.0 Last revision 01/06/07' (a 2007 Zetex model).
